exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda: o que o Ben fez no domingo?
exercise.listen: On Saturday I worked all day, but on Sunday I slept late and visited my parents.
options: Dormiu até tarde e visitou os pais.
Foi à praia com os pais.
exercise.explanation_pt: "On Sunday I slept late and visited my parents": no domingo ele dormiu até tarde e visitou os pais. Ele trabalhou no sábado.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda: onde fica a farmácia?
exercise.listen: Go straight on and turn right at the traffic lights. The pharmacy is next to the bakery.
options: Virando à direita no semáforo, ao lado da padaria.
Virando à esquerda no semáforo, em frente à padaria.
Seguindo em frente, atrás da padaria.
exercise.explanation_pt: "Turn right at the traffic lights" é virar à direita no semáforo, e "next to the bakery" é ao lado da padaria.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça a recepcionista e responda: o café da manhã está incluído?
exercise.listen: Your room is on the second floor. Breakfast isn't included, but you can buy it at the restaurant for fifteen dollars.
options: Não. Custa quinze dólares no restaurante.
Não. Custa cinquenta dólares no quarto.
exercise.explanation_pt: "Breakfast isn't included": não está incluído. "Fifteen" (15) tem a força no fim: fif-TEEN.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que você vai de ônibus.
exercise.listen: How do you usually get to work?
accepted: By bus
I go by bus
I usually go by bus
I go to work by bus
I usually go to work by bus
I take the bus
I usually take the bus
I get there by bus
I catch the bus

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Meio de transporte usa "by": "by bus". Ou diga "I take the bus".
commonErrors.correction_en: I usually go to work by bus.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pegar o ônibus" é "take the bus" ou "catch the bus".

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça o convite e recuse com educação: você não pode, já tem um compromisso.
exercise.listen: Would you like to have dinner with us tonight?
accepted: Sorry, I can't. I have plans
Sorry, I can't. I've got plans
I'm sorry, I can't. I already have plans
I'm afraid I can't. I have plans
Thanks, but I can't. I have plans
Thanks for asking, but I'm afraid I can't. I have plans
I'd love to, but I can't. I have plans
I'd love to, but I have plans
Sorry, I can't tonight. I have other plans
Sorry, I'm busy tonight

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falso cognato: "compromise" é um acordo. "Compromisso" é "plans".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry, I can't. I have plans.
Sorry, I can't. I have plans.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu não fui à festa. Eu fiquei em casa."
accepted: I didn't go to the party. I stayed at home
I did not go to the party. I stayed at home
I didn't go to the party. I stayed home
I didn't go to the party because I stayed at home

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "didn't" o verbo volta à forma base: "didn't go".
commonErrors.correction_en: I didn't go to the party. I stayed at home.
I didn't go to the party. I stayed at home.

exercise.instruction_pt: No restaurante, diga em inglês: "Eu gostaria do peixe, por favor."
accepted: I'd like the fish, please
I would like the fish, please
Could I have the fish, please?
Can I have the fish, please?
I'll have the fish, please
Can I get the fish, please?
The fish, please

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I like" é "eu gosto". Para pedir, use "I'd like" (eu gostaria).
"I want" soa seco para o garçom. Prefira "I'd like" ou "Could I have".

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu estou com dor de garganta há dois dias."
accepted: I've had a sore throat for two days
I have had a sore throat for two days
I've had a sore throat for 2 days
I've got a sore throat. It started two days ago
I have a sore throat. It started two days ago
My throat has been hurting for two days
My throat has hurt for two days

commonErrors.correction_en: I've had a sore throat for two days.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para quantidade de tempo usamos "for": "for two days".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've had a sore throat for two days.

commonErrors.match: ^i have a sore throat for two days\b
commonErrors.explanation_pt: Algo que começou no passado e continua usa "I've had... for": "I've had a sore throat for two days".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've had a sore throat for two days.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "No ano que vem eu vou estudar na Irlanda."
accepted: Next year I'm going to study in Ireland
Next year I am going to study in Ireland
I'm going to study in Ireland next year
I am going to study in Ireland next year
I'm studying in Ireland next year
Next year I'll study in Ireland
I'm planning to study in Ireland next year

commonErrors.correction_en: Next year I'm going to study in Ireland.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No ano que vem" é só "next year".
commonErrors.correction_en: Next year I'm going to study in Ireland.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Este celular é mais barato, mas aquele é melhor."
accepted: This phone is cheaper, but that one is better
This phone is cheaper, but that one's better
This phone is cheaper but that phone is better
This cell phone is cheaper, but that one is better
This mobile is cheaper, but that one is better
This one is cheaper, but that one is better

commonErrors.correction_en: This phone is cheaper, but that one is better.
This phone is cheaper, but that one is better.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ligue cada palavra de viagem ao seu significado.
O médico te dá um papel para comprar o remédio na farmácia. Como se chama esse papel em inglês?
exercise.explanation_pt: Receita médica é "prescription". "Recipe" é receita de comida e "receipt" é recibo.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ligue cada adjetivo ao seu significado.
Qual frase quer dizer "Eu pretendo mudar de emprego"?
exercise.explanation_pt: Falso cognato: "pretend" é fingir. "Pretender" é "intend" ou "plan".

exercise.instruction_pt: Ligue cada expressão de telefone ao seu significado.
Complete com o passado de "buy".
exercise.sentence: Last weekend I ___ a new jacket.
accepted: bought

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Buy" é irregular: o passado é "bought". Cuidado: "brought" é o passado de "bring" (trazer).
commonErrors.correction_en: Last weekend I bought a new jacket.

exercise.instruction_pt: Complete a comparação.
exercise.sentence: My new apartment is bigger ___ my old one.
accepted: than

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois do comparativo vem "than" (do que). Cuidado com "then", que é "então".
commonErrors.correction_en: My new apartment is bigger than my old one.

exercise.instruction_pt: Complete o conselho.
exercise.sentence: You ___ see a doctor about that cough.
accepted: should
ought to
need to
must

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "should" o verbo vem sem "to": "You should see a doctor".
commonErrors.correction_en: You should see a doctor about that cough.

exercise.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa para formar a pergunta.
accepted: What are you going to do on Sunday

exercise.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa para formar o convite.
accepted: Would you like to come to the beach with us
